notes: The we of we are all undone is given to the suffix of כֻּלָּנוּ rather than to the finite verb אָבָדְנוּ. This is defensible — a present pronominal morpheme takes the written pronoun and the ASV writes no of us for rule 19's all of them shape — but the competing reading, marking the suffix unrepresented under rule 22 and giving the verb we are undone as its parallel אָבַדְנוּ has it, is materially different and should have been named in that unit's note under rule 8. Recorded here rather than changed, since the accepted reading stands.
כֹּל takes all and never all of, per rule 19; the alignment follows the surface and morphology against MACULA's reversed gloss on כֻּלָּנוּ, which is exactly rule 39's cited case.
